features.name: 3-panel editor with GeoGebra-style tool tiles
features.limitation: Desktop triple panel, mobile drawers, now keyboard virtual-list navigation and trapped import/export Tab loops; real screen-reader/touch behavior remains unverified. Cut19 adds multiline textarea editing for text, diagram nodes and morphisms, with focus-safe commit-on-change semantics.

features.name: Semantic live dependency references and midpoint
features.limitation: Cut08 rejects newly collapsing live segments/angles/rectangles/circles/regular polygons/diagram morphisms during coordinate edits or drags; imported legacy degeneracies remain supported. No general constraint solver, auto-symmetry or collision-proof arbitrary topology.

features.name: 2D cursor drawing primitives
features.limitation: 2D cursor shapes including live two-anchor rectangles, regular polygons and per-object points. Old polygon rectangles remain polygons. General geometry constraints absent. Cut17: offscreen bounded scene geometry is conservatively culled in SVG; objects remain in the project. Labels and unbounded curves need separate safe strategies. Cut19 culls wholly offscreen text/node SVG with conservative font bounds; all model objects and crossing morphisms remain intact.

features.name: Programmatic objects and explicit f(x) graphs
features.limitation: Cut11 offers Fast/Balanced/Detailed screen sampling, capped at 80k function evaluations per path and explicit incomplete-plot state. Not exact symbolic plotting or guaranteed detection of narrow poles/spikes.

features.name: Configurable immediate path correction
features.limitation: Live corrected freehand preview matches committed smoothing, with canceled gesture rollback; no geometric shape recognition or auto-tangency.

features.name: A priori snap customization
features.limitation: Cut11 lazily indexes visible, nontransparent points/midpoints in a 32px screen grid; snap ties retain first-created anchor, hit-test ties use top layer. Cache invalidates on mutations/zoom/resize. No exact intersection snapping. Cut12 uses the pre-gesture screen-space anchor index also for multi-vertex finishing; 2,400-point strict legacy-scan oracle verified identical references and inserted points.

features.name: 6 preset workspaces and editable settings
features.limitation: Cut11 adds Plot detail (Fast, Balanced, Detailed), with Analysis / plots preset selecting Detailed and legacy v1 defaulting Balanced. Workspaces remain customizable but not user-named.

features.name: Document undo/redo and local autosave
features.limitation: 80 snapshots/30MiB older-history budget. Cut16: matching concurrent save bytes are idempotently synchronized; stale storage events read the latest saved state; quota failures offer a Retry local save button. Web Locks serializes normal saves only where supported. Pagehide, non-Web Locks, real multi-tab crash atomicity and auto-merge remain unverified or unsupported.

features.name: Infinite mathematical canvas and A4/Letter guide
features.limitation: A4/Letter landscape page guides and infinite canvas, with runtime/schema rejection of page-only export when infinite; no physical print scale.

features.name: SVG viewport export
features.limitation: Cuts 05–08 marker-free arrows and grid/page crop; XML-illegal labels now fail project validation. Browser Unicode/font fidelity unverified across engines. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them. Cut19 preserves display-wrapped spaces and renders author newlines in text/morphism as SVG tspans; browser font parity remains unverified.

features.name: PNG/JPEG/WebP via SVG→Canvas
features.limitation: Cut09: PNG/JPEG/WebP SVG→Canvas pipeline checks revision/viewport/dialog epoch after asynchronous decode and encode, cancels stale outputs, prevents simultaneous launches, and bounds each stage to 15s. Actual pixel dimensions use exact crop-to-canvas transforms. Cross-browser/glyph fidelity still unverified. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: Native editable JSON import/export
features.limitation: Native v1 editable schema; delayed file-read import is discarded if project mutated before completion; JSON remains only full semantic backup. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: TikZ export of basic geometry
features.limitation: Cut09: capability-gated for five-decimal coordinate collapse (including thin shapes) and conservative ±300 cm world range, as well as existing visible-object/ASCII limits. Not a full TeX numeric/font fidelity certification. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: Semantic TikZ import
features.limitation: TikZ uses stable zoom-independent line widths, excludes hidden unsupported shapes from capability checks, and retains only a restricted static depiction; actual TeX font parity and math-label parsing not yet complete.

features.name: Semantic topology/category/diagram chase system and tikz-cd
features.limitation: Semantic nodes/morphisms, restricted tikz-cd interchange, opt-in obstacle-aware arrows and morphism-label avoidance with handle-based manual placement. Not global graph crossing minimization, exact TeX typesetting or collision-free layout.

features.name: Strict semantic tikz-cd interchange
features.limitation: Restricted grid, escaped \& inside node labels; export verifies graph/label roundtrip and disables unsafe documents; no arbitrary TikZ macros or layout/style parity.

features.name: Cross-tab autosave conflict warning and selectable resolution
features.limitation: Existing Web Locks conflict detection remains best-effort; Cut09 attempted true two-tab mock HTTPS origin but Chromium blocked navigation, so authentic shared-origin atomicity remains unverified.

features.name: Pointer cancellation, overlap-safe geometric point selection
features.limitation: Cut09 adds window-blur and hidden-visibility abort before autosave to existing pointercancel/lostcapture rollback. Tested with synthetic browser blur; actual touchscreen focus transitions unverified.

features.name: IMO/Olympiad construction constraints and angle markers
features.limitation: 2D angle mark and Bézier added; constraints/intersections/circumcircle/tangent still planned

features.limitation: Pixels bounded to 36 MP and 16384 side; no physical DPI or calibration. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: Corrupted local save quarantine
features.limitation: Isolated mocked localStorage verifies no implicit overwrite; real multi-tab atomicity, quota/crash recovery remain unverified.

features.name: Safe literal TeX label escaping
features.limitation: TikZ uses stable zoom-independent line widths, excludes hidden unsupported shapes from capability checks, and retains only a restricted static depiction; actual TeX font parity and math-label parsing not yet complete.

features.name: Per-object point radius
features.limitation: New points store individual 1–100 px radius; legacy v1 points without property inherit document-wide radius; TikZ uses approximate physical scaling.

features.name: Strict semantic loss guard for tikz-cd
features.limitation: Export reimports and checks graph; unsafe ampersands/embedded commands disable export; full TeX options and pixel styling unsupported.

features.name: Live corrected freehand feedback and pointer-up completion
features.limitation: Path redraw/Chaikin smoothing can be slow for lengthy strokes; no recognition of circles or arbitrary shape fitting.

features.name: Rejected detached-property/row actions on reused object IDs
features.limitation: Identity guards cover object-list and property controls; other asynchronous browser tasks still need ongoing audits.

features.name: Recognize identical cross-tab saves
features.limitation: Synthetic storage-event Chromium test; real multi-tab simultaneous writes are not atomic.

features.name: Zero-opacity canvas/export label and hit-target consistency
features.limitation: Object remains in JSON and dependency graph; SVG/TikZ rendered label transparency tested, pixel-perfect image comparison pending. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: Offscreen point culling and bounded object list
features.limitation: Only point objects have conservative viewport culling; other shapes and text still render full SVG per frame; no 60 FPS guarantee at 3000 points.

features.name: Indexed large-scene left-panel search
features.limitation: Cut08 4,000-object synthetic graph filter median 6.9ms vs Cut07 28.7ms in isolated Chromium, six query changes; not a full-frame or cross-device benchmark.

features.name: Pointer-blocking export dialog with dismissible backdrop and keyboard trap
features.limitation: Verified in isolated Chromium; full ARIA/inert/accessibility and hosted mobile behavior unverified. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: Viewport-clipped infinite straight lines
features.limitation: Only viewport depiction is clipped; TikZ export remains a finite extension.

features.name: Boundary-aware semantic morphism display
features.limitation: Approximate font metrics; overlapping boxes can suppress visible arrow without deleting graph relation.

features.name: Bounded caching of explicit function SVG paths
features.limitation: Does not certify plotting topology or remove full-scene DOM redraw.

features.name: Object list Arrow/Home/End navigation
features.limitation: Isolated Chromium keyboard tests pass; screen-reader announcements and full keyboard-only geometry unverified.

features.name: Multiline screen-space semantic node labels
features.limitation: Wraps labels without deleting semantic text, supports explicit newlines and matches arrow node-box measurements; font widths are approximate, not actual font/TeX layout. TikZ geometric export is disabled when auto-wrapped.

features.name: Fit includes fixed-pixel labels and node boxes
features.limitation: Fit reserves space for node/text/point labels; huge labels on narrow screens may still overflow and trigger warning. Does not solve infinite/unbounded graph fitting. Cut12 ignores fully transparent outlier objects and semantic arrows to invisible diagram nodes when fitting visible objects; no scene objects are deleted or changed.

features.name: Screen-spatial indexed snapping and point picking
features.limitation: Microbenchmark only; full SVG redraw and very dense overlapping anchor cells may still be slow; no GPU acceleration.

features.name: Preset state, keyboard deletion safety and right-panel undo
features.limitation: Single-tab isolated Chromium tested. Presets control drawing/toolkit defaults only; advanced toolbar, IME, screen readers and real touch remain unverified.

features.name: Preserve older point radius across default-size updates
features.limitation: Materializes optional v1 style.pointSize at explicit default-size change, preserving prior appearance; old JSON remains importable.

features.name: Avoid full SVG rebuild on export-only settings changes
features.limitation: Only exportRegion/exportGuides/exportScale are render-free; undo/redo still redraw, and JSON validation remains linear in document size. Cut17: zero-opacity shapes omitted; TikZ refuses arrows with zero-opacity node endpoints rather than misleadingly drawing them.

features.name: Transient multi-click draft isolation across New/Open/tab interruption
features.limitation: Synthetic document-hidden and isolated Chromium checks; actual background suspension unverified

features.name: Project identity guard against late native JSON read
features.limitation: Delayed File.text() verified in isolated Chromium; no actual filesystem contention test

features.name: IME composition keyboard safety and gesture rollback before viewport changes
features.limitation: Synthetic IME events and zoom during mouse drag verified; real IME/touch hardware unverified

features.description: Optional bounded screen-space grid places point-name labels around point markers with approximate collision reduction.
features.limitation: No guaranteed collision-free result, exact font measurement, arbitrary text/node/morphism label routing, or per-label manual offset. Opt-in layout costs CPU; TikZ is disabled for affected scenes.

features.name: Opt-in obstacle-aware semantic morphism routing
features.limitation: Four deterministic two-turn candidates; blocked result dashed amber, source/target overlap suppresses SVG; not optimal, no arrow-to-arrow or full text collision guarantee. Default remains direct.

features.name: Manual morphism label position, distance and X/Y offsets
features.limitation: Screen-space label adjustment only, not true TeX font anchoring or collision-free placement. Unsupported TikZ visual export disabled; native JSON and SVG supported.

features.name: Direct screen-space dragging of morphism labels
features.limitation: Available on selected visible unlocked labeled morphisms. An automatic label becomes manual on drag, preserving its visual location and one undo step. Hardware touch/cross-browser behavior unverified.

features.name: Opt-in best-effort morphism-label decluttering
features.limitation: Only visible diagram-node rectangles and morphism-label rectangles are considered. Deterministic bounded screen-space candidates, not guaranteed collision free; crowded cases amber with warning. Manual labels take priority; dragging an auto label commits explicit offsets and exits auto mode. No arrow-path crossing avoidance, exact TeX text metrics, guarantee for extreme fonts, or non-Chromium testing. TikZ disabled for visible opted-in arrows.

features.name: Opt-in diagram arrow-crossing reduction
features.limitation: Screen-space, stable document-order crossings with earlier visible arrows only; two-turn corridors, 128 prior-arrow limit, 8192 segment comparisons/candidate, no global planarity or minimum-crossing guarantee. A blocked/crossing/capacity path is amber/dashed; legacy direct/avoid unchanged, TikZ visual export disabled.

features.name: Opt-in bounded later-and-earlier morphism crossing refinement
features.limitation: No global optimality; at most 48 drawable arrows and two passes. Collinear/T contact checked; Bézier/stroke/arrowheads approximate. Older modes frozen. Capacity and remaining crossings warned. TikZ visual disabled; JSON v1 preserves mode.
